apps.localizedDescription:
This is the nightly testing build of the EU Enabler. Only use this if you're interested in new features and do not care about stability. Enables installing EU/Japan Marketplace apps by overriding App Store eligibility and spoofing the device region. Built on the DarkSword exploit. Supports iOS 16.0 - iOS 18.7.1 & iOS 26.0.x, excluding M5 and A19.

For more information, check out our GitHub! https://github.com/TheDuckMan64/lara.
